cohort: The study included 200 nulliparous women with term pregnancies and single cephalic presentation, who presented with spontaneous rupture of membranes and active phase of labor.
finding: An amniotic fluid lactate (AFL) level higher than 10.1 mmol/L was significantly associated with a higher rate of cesarean delivery (75% vs 22.9%, P < 0.001).
mod_finding: AFL levels >10.1 mmol/L in nulliparous women with single-term pregnancy can be used as a marker for predicting cesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: Spontaneous rupture of membranes and active phase of labor
